title: An 11-year-old becomes the youngest woman grandmaster in chess

vocab.articleQuote: In late September at a huge international chess tournament in Uzbekistan, 11-year-old Bodhana Sivanandan of England made history.
vocab.meaning: A tournament is a set of games where many players or teams compete. At the end, one of them wins. In the article, Bodhana played in a huge chess tournament with players from many countries.
examples: Our school had a spelling tournament, and I made it to the last round.
My brother played in a soccer tournament that lasted all weekend.

vocab.articleQuote: That made her the youngest person to represent England in any sport.
vocab.meaning: To represent a place means to speak or play for it. You stand in for everyone from that place. In the article, Bodhana played on the team for England, so she represented her whole country.
examples: Our class picked Mia to represent us at the school meeting.
The swimmer was proud to represent her town at the big race.

vocab.articleQuote: She has to balance her chess life with school and other interests like reading and playing the piano and violin.
vocab.meaning: To balance two things means to make time for both of them. You do not forget one to do the other. In the article, Bodhana balances chess with school, books and music.
examples: I balance my homework and my playtime so I can do both.
Dad balances his work and time with our family.

quiz.question: How did Bodhana first learn to play chess?
options: A teacher showed her at school
She read a book at the library
quiz.explanation: Bodhana had no chess teacher. She learned by watching videos on YouTube.

quiz.question: What record did Bodhana set?
options: She is the tallest chess player ever
She is the youngest woman grandmaster ever
She played the most games in one day
She is the oldest chess champion
quiz.explanation: At age 11, she became the youngest woman grandmaster in the world.

quiz.question: Bodhana played in a big chess tournament. What is a tournament?
options: A game played by only one person
A set of games where many players compete
quiz.explanation: A tournament is a set of games where many players or teams compete.

quiz.question: Why does Bodhana use a booster seat when she plays chess?
options: So she can see and reach the board easily
quiz.explanation: A booster seat helps her see and reach the chess board.

quiz.question: What does Bodhana want to do next?
quiz.explanation: She is working to become an international master. Then she wants to keep going and keep making history.
